finding: Unbounded reference basis full mass condition 3.43e13 at block boundary; exact null filtering is insufficient to justify this badly conditioned dynamic solve. No dynamic run used it.
selected: Open quadratic B-spline basis on unchanged block bounds; 216 / 10648 control points for 512 / 64000 particles. The word clamped refers to knots, not fixed physical supports.
choice_scope: Numerical spatial basis within approved mechanics redesign; material, physical box, mass, particles, supports and cut limits unchanged. Block only, not automatic cut/tomato support.
source_context: Small-support ill conditioning documented in Yamaguchi et al 2021 https://doi.org/10.1002/nme.6598. This uses an ordinary fitted open basis, not a claimed implementation of their EBS algorithm.
